QuestInfo.name: Pink Power Superstar
QuestInfo.0: You've been feeling more confident in your abilities, but #p3000018# wants to talk to you...
QuestInfo.1: #p3000018# wants to enter into... THE FINAL CONTRACT. He even agreed to tell you the secret behind the Dress-Up system.
QuestInfo.2: Now you know the truth, and you don't know if you're any better off for it. But #p3000018# helped you become a true idol of the battlefield!

0.0: #h0#, my little pink dumpling! You look so confident and... zesty.\r\n#L0##bYa think so? I'm feeling pretty super!#l\n#k
0.1: Of course you are! My outstanding tutelage produces only the best.\r\n#L0##bI don't think I could have made it this far without you, Eskalade! You're just the best dragon a gal could have. #l\n#k
0.2: Oh, my goodness, no, don't... stop... Say, since you're feeling more pliable than usual, maybe it would be a good time to agree to the final contract.\r\n#L0##bThat sounds more ominous than usual. #l\n#k
0.3: What?! No! No way. It's just... you know, like the last thing. The big power-up. The game changer. C'mon, you have to say yes. Remember how much I helped you?

yes.0: I'll give you one more infusion of my power. This is all I have! I'm baring my soul in the ultimate dragon bond!
yes.1: Oh, I, uh... I have something to tell you about the whole Dress-Up thing too. So just, you know, whenever you're ready...

no.0: Don't be afraid to commit! Commit to me. Commit right now.

1.0: I have to tell you something before the final contract. I've been keeping a secret.\r\n#L0##bWhat is it?#l\n#k
1.1: So, you know the whole Dress-Up thing? That's... well it doesn't have anything to do with my powers. I just think you're really... you know... hot. \r\n#L0##bYeah, I kinda figured that out about 100 levels ago. #l\n#k
1.2: What?! Are you serious?! Why didn't you tell me? I thought we said no secrets! \r\n#L0##bWe literally never said that. Besides, look how cute I am!#l\n#k
1.3: That's great! Because the final contract comes with a VERY revealing new top that-- \r\n#L0##bNo more funny-business, buster! It's all business-business from here out.#l\n#k
1.4: Fine, we can get this contract finished... but that top was a lot more aerodynamic.

yes.0: How do you feel? More powerful? More receptive to my charms?

default.0: Something's weird. The final contract's not working... I swear this never happens.
